[NERR.3.1] Codes are grouped by numeric range; each range maps to a subsystem
and a recovery disposition.

| Range | Category | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| `0`          | OK                         | continue |
| `-1..-99`    | Generic                    | check args / state, fix and retry |
| `-100..-199` | Input                      | fix the input: the fact, the text or the encoded body that does not fit |
| `-200..-299` | Runtime                    | check fact / activation state |
| `-400..-499` | Storage / callbacks        | check integrator-side wiring |
| `-500..-599` | Artefact load              | rebuild the `.dsc`; check version. The DSC container's codes are `-500..-549` ([NERR.8.1]); the AOT code loader's band is `-550..-599`, and none of its codes is live ([NERR.9.1]); `-505`, `-508..-513`, `-520..-527` and `-550..-553` reserved |
| `-600..-610` | Native Rete / realtime     | check the rule network / RT config |
| `-620..-625` | Series-backend ABI         | at `ds_engine_cache_callbacks`, rebuild the host against this header; any other is a defect in libds's own backend registration ([NERR.10.2]); `-624..-625` reserved |
| `-700..-704` | Dialect / artefact binding | rebuild artefacts from one consistent source; `-702` reserved ([NERR.11.1]) |
| `-710..-714` | Realtime contract          | see NRTM |
| `-720..-730` | Event-trace                | trace session header + replay refusals + unknown inject-band atom; `-721..-724` reserved ([NERR.13]) |

This table and the registers of [IERR.2] are one register in two places, and
the second is authoritative: [IERR.2.8a] and [IERR.2.8b] for `-500..-599`,
[IERR.2.8.1] beyond it. Compiler diagnostics appear in
neither: they are not `ds_status_t` values ([RTCT.9.1]).

A category is the project's name for its family. A binding that exposes the
families as types must name each type for its category, in the binding
language's idiom, and must not name a family for what another category
holds.
